standards.description: Ask and answer questions about key details in a text, prompted and supported by the teacher.
standards.ccssText: With prompting and support, ask and answer questions about key details in a text.

standards.description: Retell familiar stories, including key details, and demonstrate understanding of their central message or lesson.
standards.ccssText: With prompting and support, retell familiar stories, including key details.

standards.description: Identify characters, settings, and major events in a story with teacher support.
standards.ccssText: With prompting and support, identify characters, settings, and major events in a story.

standards.description: Ask and answer questions about unknown words in a text with teacher support.
standards.ccssText: Ask and answer questions about unknown words in a text.

standards.description: Recognize common story types such as books and poems and identify their characteristics.
standards.ccssText: Recognize common types of texts (e.g., storybooks, poems).

standards.description: Identify the author and illustrator of a story and define the role each plays in telling the story.
standards.ccssText: With prompting and support, name the author and illustrator of a story and define the role of each in telling the story.

standards.description: Describe the relationship between the illustrations and the story in which they appear with teacher support.
standards.ccssText: With prompting and support, describe the relationship between illustrations and the story in which they appear (e.g., what moment in a story an illustration depicts).

standards.description: Compare and contrast the adventures and experiences of characters in familiar stories with teacher support.
standards.ccssText: With prompting and support, compare and contrast the adventures and experiences of characters in familiar stories.

clusters.name: Range of reading and level of text complexity

standards.description: Actively engage with group reading of stories, dramas, and poems appropriate for kindergarten.
standards.ccssText: Actively engage in group reading activities with purpose and understanding.

standards.description: Ask and answer questions about key details in an informational text with teacher support.
standards.ccssText: With prompting and support, ask and answer questions about key details in a text.

standards.description: Identify the main topic and retell key details of an informational text with teacher support.
standards.ccssText: With prompting and support, identify the main topic and retell key details of a text.

standards.description: Describe the connection between two individuals, events, ideas, or pieces of information in a text with teacher support.
standards.ccssText: With prompting and support, describe the connection between two individuals, events, ideas, or pieces of information in a text.

standards.description: Ask and answer questions to clarify the meaning of unknown words and phrases in an informational text.
standards.ccssText: With prompting and support, ask and answer questions about unknown words in a text.

standards.skillName: Identify front cover and title page
standards.description: Identify the front cover, back cover, and title page of a book.
standards.ccssText: Identify the front cover, back cover, and title page of a book.

standards.description: Name the author and illustrator of a text and define the role of each in presenting the ideas or information with teacher support.
standards.ccssText: Name the author and illustrator of a text and define the role of each in presenting the ideas or information in a text.

standards.description: Describe the relationship between the illustrations and the text in which they appear with teacher support.
standards.ccssText: With prompting and support, describe the relationship between illustrations and the text in which they appear (e.g., what person, place, thing, or idea in the text an illustration depicts).

standards.description: Identify the reasons an author gives to support points in a text with teacher support.
standards.ccssText: With prompting and support, identify the reasons an author gives to support points in a text.

standards.skillName: Compare two texts on same topic
standards.description: Identify basic similarities and differences between two texts on the same topic with teacher support.
standards.ccssText: With prompting and support, identify basic similarities in and differences between two texts on the same topic (e.g., in illustrations, descriptions, or procedures).

clusters.name: Range of reading and level of text complexity

standards.description: Actively engage with group reading of informational texts appropriate for kindergarten.
standards.ccssText: Actively engage in group reading activities with purpose and understanding.

standards.description: Demonstrate understanding of how print is organized and read, including directionality and one-to-one word correspondence.
standards.ccssText: Demonstrate understanding of the organization and basic features of print.

subStandards.description: Follow words from left to right, top to bottom, and page by page.
subStandards.ccssText: Follow words from left to right, top to bottom, and page by page.

subStandards.description: Recognize that spoken words are represented in written language by specific sequences of letters.
subStandards.ccssText: Recognize that spoken words are represented in written language by specific sequences of letters.

subStandards.description: Understand that words are separated by spaces in print.
subStandards.ccssText: Understand that words are separated by spaces in print.

subStandards.description: Recognize and name all upper- and lowercase letters of the alphabet.
subStandards.ccssText: Recognize and name all upper- and lowercase letters of the alphabet.

standards.description: Demonstrate understanding of spoken words, syllables, and sounds (phonemes) through a range of tasks.
standards.ccssText: Demonstrate understanding of spoken words, syllables, and sounds (phonemes).

subStandards.description: Recognize and produce rhyming words.
subStandards.ccssText: Recognize and produce rhyming words.

subStandards.description: Count, pronounce, blend, and segment syllables in spoken words.
subStandards.ccssText: Count, pronounce, blend, and segment syllables in spoken words.

subStandards.skillName: Blend and segment onset and rime
subStandards.description: Blend and segment onsets and rimes of single-syllable spoken words.
subStandards.ccssText: Blend and segment onsets and rimes of single-syllable spoken words.

subStandards.description: Isolate and pronounce the initial, medial vowel, and final sounds (phonemes) in three-phoneme words.
subStandards.ccssText: Isolate and pronounce the initial, medial vowel, and final sounds (phonemes) in three-phoneme (consonant-vowel-consonant, or CVC) words. (This does not include CVCs ending with /l/, /r/, or /x/.)

subStandards.description: Add or substitute individual sounds in simple one-syllable words to make new words.
subStandards.ccssText: Add or substitute individual sounds (phonemes) in simple, one-syllable words to make new words.

standards.description: Know and apply grade-level phonics and word analysis skills when decoding words.
standards.ccssText: Know and apply grade-level phonics and word analysis skills in decoding words.

subStandards.description: Demonstrate basic knowledge of one-to-one letter-sound correspondences by producing the primary sound or many of the most frequent sounds for each consonant.
subStandards.ccssText: Demonstrate basic knowledge of one-to-one letter-sound correspondences by producing the primary sound or many of the most frequent sounds for each consonant.

subStandards.description: Associate the long and short sounds with the common spellings (graphemes) for the five major vowels.
subStandards.ccssText: Associate the long and short sounds with the common spellings (graphemes) for the five major vowels.

subStandards.description: Read common high-frequency words by sight (e.g., the, of, to, you, she, my, is, are, do, does).
subStandards.ccssText: Read common high-frequency words by sight (e.g., the, of, to, you, she, my, is, are, do, does).

subStandards.description: Distinguish between similarly spelled words by identifying the sounds of the letters that differ.
subStandards.ccssText: Distinguish between similarly spelled words by identifying the sounds of the letters that differ.

standards.description: Read emergent-reader texts with purpose and understanding.
standards.ccssText: Read emergent-reader texts with purpose and understanding.

standards.description: Use drawing, dictating, and writing to express an opinion about a topic or book with a reason.
standards.ccssText: Use a combination of drawing, dictating, and writing to compose opinion pieces in which they tell a reader the topic or the name of the book they are writing about and state an opinion or preference about the topic or book (e.g., My favorite book is...).

standards.description: Use drawing, dictating, and writing to compose informative texts that name a topic and supply information about it.
standards.ccssText: Use a combination of drawing, dictating, and writing to compose informative/explanatory texts in which they name what they are writing about and supply some information about the topic.

standards.description: Use drawing, dictating, and writing to narrate a single event or linked events and provide a reaction to what happened.
standards.ccssText: Use a combination of drawing, dictating, and writing to narrate a single event or several loosely linked events, tell about the events in the order in which they occurred, and provide a reaction to what happened.

standards.description: With guidance from adults, respond to questions and suggestions to strengthen writing as needed.
standards.ccssText: With guidance and support from adults, respond to questions and suggestions from peers and add details to strengthen writing as needed.

standards.description: With guidance and support, explore a variety of digital tools to produce and publish writing.
standards.ccssText: With guidance and support from adults, explore a variety of digital tools to produce and publish writing, including in collaboration with peers.

clusters.name: Research to build and present knowledge

standards.description: Participate in shared research and writing projects to answer a question about a topic.
standards.ccssText: Participate in shared research and writing projects (e.g., explore a number of books by a favorite author and express opinions about them).

standards.description: Recall information from experiences or gather information from teacher-provided sources to answer a question.
standards.ccssText: With guidance and support from adults, recall information from experiences or gather information from provided sources to answer a question.

standards.description: Participate in collaborative conversations with diverse partners about kindergarten topics and texts with peers and adults in small and larger groups.
standards.ccssText: Participate in collaborative conversations with diverse partners about kindergarten topics and texts with peers and adults in small and larger groups.

subStandards.description: Follow agreed-upon rules for discussions, such as listening to others and taking turns speaking.
subStandards.ccssText: Follow agreed-upon rules for discussions (e.g., listening to others and taking turns speaking about the topics and texts under discussion).

subStandards.description: Continue a conversation through multiple exchanges.
subStandards.ccssText: Continue a conversation through multiple exchanges.

standards.description: Confirm understanding of a text read aloud or information presented orally by asking and answering questions about key details with teacher support.
standards.ccssText: Confirm understanding of a text read aloud or information presented orally or through other media by asking and answering questions about key details and requesting clarification if something is not understood.

standards.description: Ask and answer questions to seek help, get information, or clarify something that is not understood.
standards.ccssText: Ask and answer questions in order to seek help, get information, or clarify something that is not understood.

standards.description: Describe familiar people, places, things, and events, and provide additional detail with teacher support.
standards.ccssText: Describe familiar people, places, things, and events and, with prompting and support, provide additional detail.

standards.description: Add drawings or other visual displays to descriptions to provide additional detail.
standards.ccssText: Add drawings or other visual displays to descriptions as desired to provide additional detail.

standards.description: Speak audibly and express thoughts, feelings, and ideas clearly.
standards.ccssText: Speak audibly and express thoughts, feelings, and ideas clearly.

standards.description: Demonstrate command of the conventions of standard English grammar and usage when writing or speaking.
standards.ccssText: Demonstrate command of the conventions of standard English grammar and usage when writing or speaking.

subStandards.description: Print many upper- and lowercase letters.
subStandards.ccssText: Print many upper- and lowercase letters.

subStandards.description: Use frequently occurring nouns and verbs.
subStandards.ccssText: Use frequently occurring nouns and verbs.

subStandards.description: Form regular plural nouns orally by adding /s/ or /es/.
subStandards.ccssText: Form regular plural nouns orally by adding /s/ or /es/ (e.g., dog, dogs; wish, wishes).

subStandards.description: Understand and use question words (interrogatives) such as who, what, where, when, why, and how.
subStandards.ccssText: Understand and use question words (interrogatives) (e.g., who, what, where, when, why, how).

subStandards.description: Use the most frequently occurring prepositions.
subStandards.ccssText: Use the most frequently occurring prepositions (e.g., to, from, in, out, on, off, for, of, by, with).

subStandards.description: Produce and expand complete sentences in shared language activities.
subStandards.ccssText: Produce and expand complete sentences in shared language activities.

standards.description: Demonstrate command of the conventions of standard English capitalization, punctuation, and spelling when writing.
standards.ccssText: Demonstrate command of the conventions of standard English capitalization, punctuation, and spelling when writing.

subStandards.description: Capitalize the first word in a sentence and the pronoun I.
subStandards.ccssText: Capitalize the first word in a sentence and the pronoun I.

subStandards.description: Recognize and name end punctuation.
subStandards.ccssText: Recognize and name end punctuation.

subStandards.description: Write a letter or letters for most consonant and short-vowel sounds.
subStandards.ccssText: Write a letter or letters for most consonant and short-vowel sounds (phonemes).

subStandards.description: Spell simple words phonetically, drawing on knowledge of sound-letter relationships.
subStandards.ccssText: Spell simple words phonetically, drawing on knowledge of sound-letter relationships.

standards.description: Determine or clarify the meaning of unknown and multiple-meaning words and phrases based on kindergarten reading and content.
standards.ccssText: Determine or clarify the meaning of unknown and multiple-meaning words and phrases based on kindergarten reading and content.

subStandards.description: Identify new meanings for familiar words and apply them accurately.
subStandards.ccssText: Identify new meanings for familiar words and apply them accurately (e.g., knowing duck is a bird and learning the verb to duck).

subStandards.description: Use the most frequently occurring inflections and affixes as a clue to the meaning of an unknown word.
subStandards.ccssText: Use the most frequently occurring inflections and affixes (e.g., -ed, -s, re-, un-, pre-, -ful, -less) as a clue to the meaning of an unknown word.

standards.description: With guidance and support, explore word relationships and nuances in word meanings.
standards.ccssText: With guidance and support from adults, explore word relationships and nuances in word meanings.

subStandards.description: Sort common objects into categories to gain a sense of the concepts the categories represent.
subStandards.ccssText: Sort common objects into categories (e.g., shapes, foods) to gain a sense of the concepts the categories represent.

subStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of frequently occurring verbs and adjectives by relating them to their opposites.
subStandards.ccssText: Demonstrate understanding of frequently occurring verbs and adjectives by relating them to their opposites (antonyms).

subStandards.description: Identify real-life connections between words and their use.
subStandards.ccssText: Identify real-life connections between words and their use (e.g., note places at school that are colorful).

subStandards.description: Distinguish shades of meaning among verbs describing the same general action by acting out the meanings.
subStandards.ccssText: Distinguish shades of meaning among verbs describing the same general action (e.g., walk, march, strut, prance) by acting out the meanings.

standards.description: Use words and phrases acquired through conversations, reading, and being read to, and responding to texts.
standards.ccssText: Use words and phrases acquired through conversations, reading and being read to, and responding to texts.
